basic_info.description:
Experience two levels of unparalleled living space at 33 Clementina St, Unit 3 in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant SoMa district. This unique residence offers soaring, dramatic ceilings and picturesque Downtown city views from most rooms, creating a light-filled and inspiring atmosphere.

The spacious, open layout is ideal for modern urban living, blending comfort with striking architectural character. Just steps from the Financial District, Moscone Center, Salesforce Park, and Yerba Buena Gardens, you'll enjoy immediate access to San Francisco's premier business, dining, and cultural destinations.

With excellent connectivity via BART, Muni, and nearby freeways, this home offers the perfect combination of design, location, and convenience.
